scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the MAE vs peak_position curve and occupancy vs epsilon_d by interpolating from the agent's raw CSV and comparing to reference points extracted from the paper's Figure 4d and 4a. No self-reported metrics are trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference points for MAE vs peak_position and occupancy vs epsilon_d derived from the paper's Figs.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4d (MAE vs Coulomb peak position) and Figure 4a (occupancy vs ε_d).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximated from the paper's description: linear behaviour up to 100 meV, sublinear beyond, approaching 7.14 meV (bare D) at half-filling; occupancy ~2 at ε_d=-4 eV and increasing with impurity filling.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Points faithfully reproduce the physical trend reported in the paper and are used only for comparison; the paper itself provides qualitative and quantitative constraints that any correct simulation must respect.

outputs.description: Table mapping impurity on-site energy to occupancy, upper Coulomb peak position, and magnetic anisotropy energy, obtained by solving the two-orbital Anderson impurity model.
